### 12. Contract

Contract baseline (GAP-0670, GAP-0671, GAP-0957). The placement path `POST /api/recovery/case/v1/queues/{queueId}/placements` is provided by rwb-case under this story and keeps the behaviour of sections 4 and 12.1; the rwb-integration story RWB-P2-E2036-CON consumes it and does not own it. The rwb-integration admission operation forwards to this path and is not part of this story. The three consumed contracts are the rwb-case placement, the rwb-case parameters contract under the key `rwb.casewf.placement.approved-callers` and the rwb-access authorise contract; their JSON element names are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0671; GAP-0957) until their owners publish them. The element names of section 12.1 are the realignment baseline for the access call; they are carried in RWB-P4-E1037-CON, reconfirmed with RWB-P2-E2036-CON at contract review, and any change is additive first. The caller type is a carried value of the approved callers list; rwb_access holds no list of caller types. The idempotency replay window is 24 hours, the platform rule.
